# Wreative Showcase

> Portfolio of website and mobile application projects by Wreative creative agency.
> Author: Wreative | Location: Surabaya, Indonesia

Total: 33 projects (27 websites, 6 mobile apps)

## Websites

### 1. Kontraktor Surabaya
- **Platform:** Website
- **URL:** [https://kontraktorsurabaya.wreative.com/](https://kontraktorsurabaya.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** WordPress, Elementor, SEO
- **Description:** Professional contracting services website for Surabaya region. Clean layout showcasing construction services, project portfolio, and client testimonials with easy contact integration.

### 2. Wase Bumi Indonesia
- **Platform:** Website
- **URL:** [https://wasebumiindonesia.wreative.com/](https://wasebumiindonesia.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** WordPress, Custom Theme, ACF
- **Description:** Corporate business website for a natural resource company. Features company profile, service offerings, and a modern design that reflects the brand's commitment to sustainability.

### 3. Cubicle Toilet
- **Platform:** Website
- **URL:** [https://cubicletoilet.wreative.com/](https://cubicletoilet.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** WordPress, WooCommerce, Elementor
- **Description:** Specialized cubicle and toilet partition services website. Product catalog with detailed specifications, project gallery, and inquiry system for commercial clients.

### 4. PT. Adikarya Pesona Intinusa

### 5. Wreative Store

### 6. Home Baraka

## Mobile Apps

### 1. Wreative App
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://wreative.com/](https://wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** React Native, Expo, Firebase, Push Notifications
- **Description:** Brand companion app for Wreative creative agency. Clients can browse the portfolio, track project progress in real-time, communicate via in-app chat, and approve deliverables directly from their phone. Push notifications keep everyone aligned on deadlines.

### 2. FoodDash — Food Delivery
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://chickenexplorer.wreative.com/](https://chickenexplorer.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Google Maps API, Midtrans
- **Description:** Cross-platform food delivery app connecting hungry users with local restaurants. Features real-time order tracking with live GPS, multiple payment gateways (GoPay, OVO, bank transfer), smart recommendation engine, and a loyalty points system.

### 3. WeddingKu — Wedding Planner
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://pernikahanini.wreative.com/](https://pernikahanini.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** React Native, TypeScript, Supabase, Midtrans
- **Description:** All-in-one wedding planning app for Indonesian couples. Browse vendor catalogs, manage guest lists with RSVP tracking, track budget across categories, timeline countdown, and mood board with Pinterest integration.

### 4. LombokRide — Transport Booking
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/](https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Google Maps SDK, Firebase, Localization
- **Description:** Transport and tour booking app for Lombok island. Book cars, scooters, and tour packages with instant confirmation. Includes offline-capable maps, driver tracking, and multi-language support (ID/EN/JP).

### 5. SG Academy Mobile
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://sgacademy.co.id/](https://sgacademy.co.id/)
- **Tech:** React Native, Zoom SDK, AWS S3, Offline-First
- **Description:** Mobile learning companion for SG Academy students. Access course materials offline, submit assignments, join live classes via integrated video conferencing, track learning progress with detailed analytics.

### 6. BE MODE — Fashion Shopping
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://bemodeofficial.com](https://bemodeofficial.com)
- **Tech:** Flutter, TensorFlow Lite, ARCore, Shopify API
- **Description:** Fashion e-commerce app with AR try-on for accessories, personalized style recommendations powered by ML, size guide with measurement input, wishlist sync across devices, and one-tap checkout.
